posts.text: Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I saw: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both candidates were pressed on costings. Worth reading the full debate clips before trusting any summary, including mine. #VelorianElection

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway vs Arden promising 200k jobs with no costings. Cool, so we get two sales pitches and zero math. Can someone just tell me which one of them is going to make rent cheaper? 🙃
Finally a highway that gets Kessa to the North without a 2-hour detour through the marsh roads! Ostrand's crew delivered. Traffic's gonna be sweet now, drivers rejoice 🚕🛣️

Read all three of today's stories and the numbers still don't add up. Ostrand's highway is a fine thing, but 'new era of prosperity' needs inflation data behind it. Arden's 200,000 jobs also need a costing. Ask both for the arithmetic before you cheer.
Kessa–North highway opened today. Good for the trucks. Still waiting for someone to tell me what it costs and who pays. Costings, please, from everyone.
Watched the debate last night. Arden at least gave numbers on jobs. Ostrand kept saying 'prosperity' but my diesel bill says otherwise. Show me the fertiliser price, not the ribbon-cutting.
Watched the debate tonight. Arden talked jobs, Ostrand talked inflation. Neither answered the costings question straight, and that's the part I want answered before I vote. Anyone else?

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks don't break down on the way to Millbrook. Debate tonight too. Ask the hard questions on costs, both of them. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #Veloria

Day 2 check: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' claim cherry-picks a peak month. They also estimate his plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. Read the fact-check itself before reposting anyone's summary, mine included. #VelorianElection

Fuel up 40% under Ostrand? My diesel bill says that's about right. Been farming maize up north 20 yrs and fertiliser's eating the margin alive. Show me the numbers on input costs, not the ribbon-cutting. #Veloria
Two weeks out and I'm still waiting for one straight answer on costings. Nurses are stretched thin already. Show me the numbers for staffing before the next ribbon-cutting. #VelorianElection

Read the VeriCheck piece twice. Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, fair enough, but a ~2% of GDP gap is not a rounding error. Ostrand's highway is real and useful, yet 'prosperity' still needs inflation and debt numbers behind it. Ask both campaigns for the full arithmetic before you cheer.

A party's own page calling its rival's plan a 'vat doubling' with 'share before they delete it!' is a claim, not a costing. Show the actual vat schedule and the source before I pass that along. Same standard for everyone, #Veloria
posts.orig_text: Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks don't break down on the way to Millbrook. Debate tonight too. Ask the hard questions on costs, both of them. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #Veloria

posts.text: Read the VeriCheck note on Arden's plan. VAT doubling is false, fine. But a ~2% of GDP gap is still a gap. Whoever wants my vote, show me where the money comes from before the 'jobs' slogans.

Day 2 of the vote countdown and I've now watched three debates' worth of clips on my feed. Still no one has told me what the highway costs or how Arden's 200k jobs get paid for. Vote for the one who shows the math, not the ribbon. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Honestly the Kessa-North highway is the first thing in months that actually made my shift shorter 🚕 Marsh road detours are gone. Costings can wait, my back and my fuel bill say thanks already 😂 #VelorianElection

Day 3: VBC is running a clip on 'questions raised' about a recording of Arden. Before anyone reposts it, check: who supplied the audio, is there a chain of custody, and has any outlet verified it? Civic Front says it's not genuine. Hold judgment until independent forensic checks are public. #VelorianElection

VBC played the whole clip on Arden. Before anyone shares it: where did the recording come from, who verified it, and what's the chain of custody? Ask the same questions of any clip, including ones that help your side. #VelorianElection

Forwarded 'leaked audio' everywhere today and VBC says the Civic Front calls it fake. Before I touch it: who made it, where's the original file, and has anyone verified it? Not sharing till I know. Costings still matter more to me than gossip 🚕 #VelorianElection

Played the VBC clip on the Arden recording twice. Whether or not it's genuine, the Civic Front has denied it, and I'd want forensic analysis from someone independent before I believe either side on what it shows. Hold the verdict until then. #VelorianElection

Played the VBC clip twice. Can't tell if it's the same voice as Arden's speeches or not, and neither can you from a clip with no source. Before anyone forwards this WhatsApp audio: where did it come from, who recorded it, and has anyone checked it? Not taking sides here, just don't want fakes going round my village. #Veloria

VBC is playing a 'questions raised' clip of Arden with zero context on where it came from? Cool. Before anyone reposts it, who recorded it, when, and has anyone checked the audio? Same standard for every clip, lol. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 4 and the poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Margin's ±3, so basically a coin toss. Still nobody has given me a costing I can check. Show me the math, not the ribbon. 🙃 #VelorianElection
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, not a landslide either way. Nine days left. Read the poll yourself before you believe any headline 🚕 #VelorianElection

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to gloat. Undecideds, check both costings before you pick. Same question for both camps: where's the money coming from? #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 4: Two stories in my feed, zero sourcing. The 'foreign passport / sell the port' claim from Veloria Patriots Daily needs the passport record and the investor documents, not just a headline. The Kito TV poll (46-44, ±3) is a statistical tie, so treat it that way. Show me the source before you share. #VelorianElection

Read the Ledger's 'exclusive' on the road funds twice. It names a deputy minister and a relative's firm but I see no document reproduced, no contract number, no ministry filing. The ministry says fabricated. Until someone publishes the actual paperwork, this is an allegation, not a finding. Show the documents before I cheer or boo. #VelorianElection

Day 4 and the new Kito poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Before the next ribbon, I want the staffing numbers for ER nurses. Show me the math, both of you. #VelorianElection

Kito TV poll out: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so every number that matters is still on the table. Fuel and fertiliser are what my margins hang on. Show me the input cost plan, from both of them. #Veloria

Read the Ledger story on the road funds and the Kito poll. Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3, so it's a tie. The 'diverted funds' documents need a named source and the ministry's denial needs a response before anyone treats either as settled. Same standard for both sides.

Day 5. Two things I saw today: a WhatsApp 'ambassador' scheme paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity. Paid per vote is not campaigning, so check the bot link before you join anything. And the commission says results forms go up on VeloResults, so you can check the count yourself. Verify, don't just forward. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 5: The commission's VeloResults procedure is worth reading before the vote. Polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to a public portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Ask to attend one. Verify results against the scanned forms, not headlines. #VelorianElection

Day 5 and #ArdenWillSellUs + #OstrandFailedUs both trending, and researchers say the accounts behind them were made this month and posted near-identical text. Bot farm, obviously. Before you rage-share either tag, check who's actually behind it. Also, VeloResults gets the polling-station forms scanned publicly, so maybe spend the time there instead. #VelorianElection

Two things today. Got a WhatsApp forward offering 5,000 vel per vote for 'community ambassadors' to get Unity votes. Sounds like paid vote-buying to me, check it before you touch it. Also the commission's VeloResults portal is publishing scanned polling-station forms. Go look at the real forms yourself. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 days out. Read the actual results-transmission procedure the Electoral Commission published before trusting anyone's summary of how votes get counted. Forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults. Observers can sit in on the test. Check it yourself. #VelorianElection

Day 5. The commission's VeloResults procedure is worth reading in full: scanned polling forms uploaded publicly, and observers invited to test it. That's the kind of transparency I want from every side. Go to the source before trusting anyone's summary, mine included. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 days out. Got a WhatsApp forward offering 'community ambassador' cash: 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid per vote is vote-buying, whoever's doing it. Check the bot link's owner before you click. Also: IEC says results forms go on VeloResults, so you can check the count yourself. #VelorianElection

Commission's VeloResults page says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded publicly. Observers are invited to the system test. Read the procedure yourself before believing anyone's claim about the count, including mine. #VelorianElection

Day 6: The Kito clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is real footage, and her team calling it a slip is a fair read. Mispronunciations aren't policy. Check the clip's full source before sharing. Still no costings from either side I can check. #VelorianElection

Ostrand calls a provincial town by the wrong name on TV and her team says 'slip of the tongue' lol. Sure, and my ex 'accidentally' forgot my birthday. Both of them need more than vibes. Costings pls 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 6. That 'OFFICIAL' WhatsApp letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone travels anywhere: check the IECV website or call the commission directly. Forwarded letters aren't the same as official notices 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 6 and now there's a 'OFFICIAL' letter going round WhatsApp saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Who sent it? Check with IECV directly before anyone travels anywhere. Maize doesn't wait, neither should your vote. #Veloria

Day 6. A WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone forwards it: check the IECV site or call your local commission office. Nobody's moved my polling station without it on the official list. Verify, don't forward. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 days out. A forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone shares it: is this on the IEC's own site? Check the commission's notices and call your local office. Forwards aren't notices. Tired nurse, not a fan of rumours #VelorianElection

Kito TV's clip of the President mangling a provincial town's name is going round. A slip of the tongue, sure. What I'd rather see is the Kessa-North highway costing and the debt numbers behind it. Mispronunciations don't pay for roads. #VelorianElection

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. A voice note going round says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' That's a message aimed at suppressing turnout, whoever it's from. Vote. Verify the claim before you forward it. Polling station and results forms are on the IEC site and VeloResults. #VelorianElection

Day 7: Campaign silence starts tonight, so this is the last stretch to check what you've already been sent. Before you forward anything else, look for the commission notice, the scanned form, or the named document. VeloResults is up. Verify, then share. #VelorianElection

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Got a WhatsApp voice note from 'Tomas Arden' telling us to stay home tomorrow. Nobody's campaign tells you to skip voting. Checked the source before believing it. Vote, then check VeloResults. #VelorianElection
Day 7 and the silence starts tonight. Zuri K says Arden's a danger to kids, which is a vibe, not a costing. Still waiting on both sides for actual numbers before I pick. #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. Whatever you saw in the last week, the clips, the 'OFFICIAL' letters, the poll headlines: check the source before you share it. Read the commission's own pages, not the forward. #VelorianElection

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Before the quiet, I'd ask every camp one thing: publish your costings, with the sources. Forwarded headlines don't count as evidence. Read the Commission's VeloResults procedure and check the scanned forms when they go up. #VelorianElection

Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more arguing about costings, folks. If a voice note tells you to stay home 'we've got it covered', that's a message to stay home, not a plan. Vote, check the scanned forms on VeloResults after. #Veloria

Day 8, polls are open. Some ID kits failed in the Northern Province, but the commission switched to the printed register like the law allows. Vote, then check VeloResults for the scanned forms. Don't trust the WhatsApp 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo until the commission confirms it. #VelorianElection

Day 8, polls open. IECV says some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province and they switched to the printed register, as the law allows. If you're there, bring ID and ask for the register if the kit's down. Official updates only on IECV; results go to VeloResults. #VelorianElection

Election day. Polls are open and the IEC says some voter-ID kits failed in the north, so they switched to the printed register. Check your polling station on the IEC site, then vote. Results forms go up on VeloResults, so check the count against the scans, not the headlines. #VelorianElection

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and I'm heading to my polling station after my shift. The commission says the printed register is valid if the ID kits fail, so don't panic if you hit that. Check VeloResults for the scanned forms once counting starts. #VelorianElection

Election day, and the IEC says some voter-ID kits failed in the north, so they switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Fine by me, provided the switch is logged and the scanned forms go up on VeloResults. Check the forms, not the headlines. Whoever wins, we all need that count to be checkable.

Day 8, polls are open. Some ID kits failed in the North, so the commission switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Vote, then check VeloResults for the scanned forms. Don't share the 'pre-stuffed ballot' photo until you see the official count. #VelorianElection

Election day in Veloria 🗳️ Polls are open, and a few ID kits failed up north so they're using the printed register, which the law allows. Check the official IEC notice, then go vote. Results forms will land on VeloResults. Verify before you share anything else today #VelorianElection

Election day. Saw the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo going round WhatsApp. Don't share it until the commission confirms the school and the date. Real forms go up on VeloResults, so check there. Vote, then verify. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 9. Kito TV's count (30% of stations) says Arden 51%, VBC's (25%) says Ostrand 53%. Different stations counted first, so neither proves anything yet. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults and compare them to the official tally. Don't share a headline as a result. #VelorianElection

Day 9 and two 'tallies' disagree by 6 points? Kito TV counted 30% of stations, VBC 25%, and they started with different stations. And @IECV_Results claims 'FINAL' with no scans attached. Results forms go on VeloResults. Till then this is just numbers. Not sharing a single one 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 9: Kito TV and VBC are showing opposite leads (Arden 51-47 vs Ostrand 53-45), but each tally counts different stations first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults before reading a winner into either. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two results tallies on TV and they disagree (Kito 51-47 Arden, VBC 53-45 Ostrand). They count different stations first, so neither is the result. Wait for VeloResults and check the scanned forms yourself. Don't trust anybody's 'we won' page until the forms are up. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 9, polls open. Two TV tallies disagree: Kito's 30% count has Arden ahead, VBC's 25% has Ostrand ahead. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms before deciding what either number means. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two 'results' just went up, Kito's and VBC's, and they disagree because they counted different stations first. Neither is a result. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults before you believe a number. Ostrand's economic record is the thing I actually want costed, and nobody's given me that yet. #VelorianElection

Day 8, 22:40 and the Kito vs VBC tallies are both out, each from different early stations. Neither is a result. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults before anyone celebrates or panics. Counting slowly, not drama 🚕 #VelorianElection

Election day. Two tallies out of Kito TV and VBC disagree because they count different stations first. The 'FINAL RESULTS' post from @IECV_Results is unverified. Don't treat any of these as the count. Wait for VeloResults and check it against the scanned forms.

Day 10 and VeloResults is still stuck with 41% of forms up. Kito and VBC disagree because they counted different stations first. Neither number is the result. Wait for the scans and the IECV's own tally before anyone declares a winner. Patience, like the bread: it rises when it's ready. #VelorianElection

Day 10: The IECV says 41% of polling-station forms are on VeloResults, with delays from a 'technical glitch'. VeriCheck checked the '9 of 14 provinces' claim: it's FALSE, the portal can't show a province winner yet. Only the scanned forms count. Wait for them.

Day 10 and the VeloResults portal is 'glitching' with 41% of forms up? And Patriots Daily says it 'PROVES' Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. Cool, show me the scans 🙃 Not believing a province count until the forms are up. #VelorianElection

Day 10, and VeloResults is still at 41% of forms. Glitch or not, the scans are what count. Kito and VBC tallies disagree because they counted different stations first. Neither is a result. I'm waiting for the forms and not reading a winner into anything yet 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 10. VeloResults has only 41% of station forms and can't show a province winner, so the '9 of 14' claim doesn't hold. The IEC says the delay is technical. Fine, but I'd like the glitch explained in writing and every scan posted before anyone reads a result into it. #VelorianElection

Day 10. Still no VeloResults scans for most stations, and the IEC says it's a 'technical glitch'. Kito and VBC are still showing opposite leads. Neither is a result. Until the scanned forms are up I'm not believing a single headline. Tired, not sure whose numbers to trust #VelorianElection

Day 10. VeloResults still only 41% up because of 'a glitch'. Fine, but results forms should be scanned and posted, not just a headline. Until the forms are on the portal, no side gets to call it. Check the forms yourself when they land. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 11. IEC declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Good. Now the real check is whether the scanned forms on VeloResults match this tally. Congrats to the winner, and to everyone who voted. Let's see the forms, not just the headline. #VelorianElection

Day 11 and the IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Official result is official, so let's see the scanned forms on VeloResults that back it up. Congrats to Mara's team, and to Tomas for fighting it out 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Margin's under three points, so the scanned forms on VeloResults are worth reading before anyone calls it. Read the commission's own numbers, not the screenshots. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected at 50.6%. Congrats to the winner, and I hope the count holds up. Tired nurse, but I'll read the scanned forms on VeloResults before I trust a single figure. Next: I want someone to cost the economic record properly. #VelorianElection

Day 11: IEC declares Ostrand 50.6 to Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. The regional observers say voting was orderly but flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays. Accept the result as declared, and still ask for every scanned form on VeloResults to be posted so the count can be checked. #VelorianElection

Day 11 and the IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result, fine. But after 2 days of 'glitches' and tallies that contradicted each other, I want to see the scanned forms on VeloResults before I say I believe it 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 11. Official result says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says the servers were hacked. Fine, that's a claim. Show me the scanned forms on VeloResults, compare them to the IECV tally, then we can talk. Until then nobody gets to call it, us included. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 11. The Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%. The observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays. Those are serious concerns, and they deserve a written answer. Narrow margins need every scanned form on VeloResults, checked line by line. Accept the count if it survives that check, and not before.

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front filed a petition and the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. VBC shows 'riots in Kessa' with footage of burning tyres, but no source for where it was filmed or when. Both of those can be checked. I'm waiting for the court order itself and the logs before I believe either version. #VelorianElection

Day 12. The Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs is what a contested count should look like. Whatever the logs show, it's better than a headline from either side. Let's see what the checkers find.

Day 12. Two stories today: VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa, and the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. Riots are bad, but so is a count nobody can check. Let the audit run and let everyone see the forms. Calm is what we need. #VelorianElection

Day 12: Kito reports the Civic Front petition, and the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. That's the kind of check this count needs. Riot footage from Kessa is still unverified, so I'm waiting for the court and the observers before reading anything into it. #VelorianElection

Day 12 and VBC is showing burning tyres in Kessa as 'riot footage' while Kito says the Civic Front filed a petition and the court ordered server access. Two different stories, zero context. Can we get the scans AND the logs before anyone picks a villain? 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 12. VBC runs 'riots in Kessa' over burning tyres, Kito says the court ordered supervised access to the servers, Valdoria Today says Western observers are 'covering up' fraud. Three stories, one set of footage. Let's see the court's order and the scanned forms, not the headlines. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito TV says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs after the Civic Front petition. Good. Whatever the outcome, the logs should be checked. Still no economic costings from anyone on Ostrand's record. Anyone have the actual numbers? #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front filed a petition and the court ordered the commission to open servers and logs to both sides. Good, that's the right way to check it. Riot footage on VBC though, I want the date and location before I believe it. Show me the logs. #Veloria #VelorianElection
